data.one_liner: Instagram‑style story UI with rich animations and high customizability.
data.what_it_does: Provides a StoryPageView widget to display a sequence of stories per page, with callbacks for page and story events. Allows custom durations per story and separate gesture widgets.
use_when: You need an Instagram‑like story carousel in a Flutter app
You want per‑story animation control and callbacks for pause, page change, etc.
avoid_when: You require a full state‑management solution
You need backend integration or storage handling
strengths: Rich animations and customizable story duration
weaknesses: Focused only on story UI, no broader features
Relies on provider for state, may be overkill for simple use
Potentially less maintained than the original package
data.setup_notes: Add story_time and provider to pubspec; no native permissions required
